ruleDefinitions.name: Important Windows Service Terminated Unexpectedly
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects important or interesting Windows services that got terminated unexpectedly. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, param1, Binary

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7034) AND (param1 = RGX(".*Message\\ Queuing.*") OR (Binary = RGX(".*4d0053004d005100.*") OR Binary = RGX(".*6d0073006d007100.*"))))
